tools.name: session__search
tools.description: Search the current session's message history for a substring (default) or regex (is_regex=true). Returns matched messages with role, index, and a context snippet. Useful for recalling earlier discussion in long sessions without rebuilding context manually.
tools.schema: {"properties":{"case_sensitive":{"description":"Case-sensitive matching (default false = case-insensitive).","type":"boolean"},"is_regex":{"description":"Treat query as a Go RE2 regex (default false = substring).","type":"boolean"},"max_results":{"description":"Cap on returned matches (default 50, max 1000).","type":"integer"},"query":{"description":"Substring or regex to search for.","type":"string"},"roles":{"description":"Restrict to specific roles (user, assistant, tool, tool_result, system). Default: all roles.","items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"},"snippet_chars":{"description":"Total chars of context around each match (default 80, max 400).","type":"integer"}},"required":["query"],"type":"object"}
